$comment: Saved camera spots (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md "Screenshots of a place"; scripts/spots.ts): <world>:<place> → the world (test:<fixture> or terrain), seed, time of day, and the camera: at [x, y, z] (the eye) or above [x, z, height over the ground there], yaw (0 = +Z, 90 = +X), pitch, face. An above spot's openY is the height its page opens at (over the ground). The starter's are its tour's (cargo test --release -p dwell-worldgen --test starter_world tour -- --ignored --nocapture, 2026-11-11). Shoot one: npm run bench -- --spot starter:broadleaf.

starter:lava-lake.notes: The starter's lava lake on its youngest hotspot island's summit (shared/worldgen/worlds/starter.json lavaVents; VOLCANOES.md §6.2)

starter:lava-lake-night.notes: The starter's lava lake by night: its glow and its light on the summit

starter:mesa.notes: The mesa with 463 m of relief in view (tour)

starter:wetland.notes: The wetland by its water (tour; WORK_QUEUE: a grassy plain with oaks under the range)

starter:volcano.notes: The volcano seen from 15 km east of its cone (tour)

starter:shore.notes: The shore facing the hotspot islands (tour)

starter:arch-1.notes: Through the first arch on the mesa's fins (feature_spots: span 12 m, rise 9 m; ADR 0074 B8, 0.52.66)

starter:arch-2.notes: Through a mesa arch on a high bench (feature_spots: span 14 m, rise 10 m)

starter:arch-3.notes: Through a mesa arch (feature_spots: span 10 m, rise 9 m)

starter:mesa-walls.notes: The red mesa's walls, 430 m of relief in view (tour: mesa with relief), looking down its canyon

starter:rainier-summit.notes: On the tall cone's highest point (feature_spots: 4839 m, off the cone's centre), looking across the broken rim toward the centre (ADR 0075 T5)

starter:rainier-flank.notes: The tall cone from 8 km east at 3000 m: cleavers, cirques, the snow and ice caps (ADR 0075 T5)

starter:glacier-edge.notes: The alpine tundra's glacier ice edge on the cone's south flank, ground at 3175 m (feature_spots: glacier_ice with bare ground 60 m east)

starter:tundra-snowline.notes: The alpine tundra's own snow line (T3b snow; feature_spots: snow with bare ground 60 m east). An exact eye: as an above spot the bench found ground at 1200 m, 72 m under the column's top (1272 m), and shot from inside the hill.

starter:steppe-sand.notes: Sand under the steppe's grass on sandy soil (T3b soilBlocks; feature_spots: a sand top with grass 60 m east)

starter:meadow-sand.notes: The meadow's sandy soil (T3b soilBlocks; feature_spots)

starter:steppe-grass.notes: The steppe's tall grass, thinned by its dry climate (T3b undergrowth; tour: preset:steppe)

starter:meadow-grass.notes: The meadow's tall grass, for comparison with the steppe's (T3b undergrowth; tour: preset:temperate_meadow)

starter:leaf-tints.notes: The broadleaf forest's oak crowns from above: per-tree leaf tints (ADR 0079 S4)

starter:leaf-tints-pines.notes: The mixed forest's crowns from above: per-tree tints on pines and oaks (ADR 0079 S4)

starter:lava-river.notes: The starter's face-B river vent on the youngest hotspot island's flank (30103, -7614; lavaVents faces b), from 45 m over the ground 54 m south of it. A fresh world shows little lava: run it after the lava rate step (`lava` rate [30], 45 s) as a scenario does.
